name: Izumizaki (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the Izumizaki village emblem in white: a stylised device of two curved horns above a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Izumizaki, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1968.

features.role: Izumizaki village emblem — a stylised device of two curved horns above a ring
